items.question: Trong câu "UI is the interface layer they see and operate.", từ "layer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UI is the interface layer they see and operate.", what does "layer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (danh từ): tầng, lớp. "Presentation layer" = tầng giao diện; kiến trúc phần mềm thường chia nhiều layer.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (noun): a level. "Presentation layer" is the UI tier; software architecture is often split into layers.

items.question: Trong câu "UI is the interface layer they see and operate.", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UI is the interface layer they see and operate.", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɑː.pə.reɪt/ (động từ): vận hành. Danh từ: operation, operator; nghĩa khác trong y khoa: phẫu thuật.
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɑː.pə.reɪt/ (verb): to use and control. Nouns: operation, operator; in medicine it means to perform surgery.

items.question: Trong câu "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", từ "harmonious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", what does "harmonious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: harmonious /hɑːrˈmoʊ.ni.əs/ (tính từ): hài hòa. Danh từ: harmony; "harmonious colours" = màu sắc hài hòa.
items.explanationEn: harmonious /hɑːrˈmoʊ.ni.əs/ (adjective): well matched. Noun: harmony; "harmonious colours" go well together.

items.question: Trong câu "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", từ "smooth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", what does "smooth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: smooth /smuːð/ (tính từ): mượt mà. "Smooth animation / transition" = chuyển động mượt; "smooth surface" = bề mặt nhẵn.
items.explanationEn: smooth /smuːð/ (adjective): flowing without jerks. "Smooth animation" has no jerks; a "smooth surface" is flat and even.

items.question: Trong câu "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", từ "refined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A ticket booking app has a beautiful interface — harmonious colours, smooth animation, refined typography.", what does "refined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: refined /rɪˈfaɪnd/ (tính từ): tinh tế. Nghĩa khác: refined sugar = đường tinh luyện; động từ refine = tinh chỉnh.
items.explanationEn: refined /rɪˈfaɪnd/ (adjective): elegant. Another sense: refined sugar is purified; verb refine means to improve in detail.

items.question: Trong câu "But to book one ticket the user passes through seven screens, re-enters information already given at step three, and cannot go back to correct it without losing everything.", từ "pass through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But to book one ticket the user passes through seven screens, re-enters information already given at step three, and cannot go back to correct it without losing everything.", what does "pass through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pass through /pæs θruː/ (cụm từ): đi qua. "Pass through several screens" = đi qua nhiều màn hình; "passing through" = chỉ ghé qua.
items.explanationEn: pass through /pæs θruː/ (phrase): to go via. "Pass through several screens"; "just passing through" means only visiting briefly.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's role is to ensure the task flow is correct and complete, so the designer has the right foundation to design from.", từ "ensure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's role is to ensure the task flow is correct and complete, so the designer has the right foundation to design from.", what does "ensure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (động từ): đảm bảo. Phân biệt ensure (đảm bảo), insure (mua bảo hiểm), assure (cam đoan với ai).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (verb): to make sure. Distinguish ensure (make certain), insure (buy insurance), assure (promise someone).

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's role is to ensure the task flow is correct and complete, so the designer has the right foundation to design from.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's role is to ensure the task flow is correct and complete, so the designer has the right foundation to design from.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "Lay the foundation" = đặt nền móng; nghĩa khác: foundation là quỹ/tổ chức.
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a base to build on. "Lay the foundation"; a foundation is also a charitable organisation.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs contribute to UX through four concrete activities:", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs contribute to UX through four concrete activities:", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): đóng góp. Cấu trúc: contribute to something; danh từ: contribution, contributor.
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to add to. Pattern: contribute to something; nouns: contribution, contributor.

items.question: Trong câu "They need to know: who, doing what, how often, in what circumstances, at what skill level.", từ "circumstance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They need to know: who, doing what, how often, in what circumstances, at what skill level.", what does "circumstance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: circumstance /ˈsɝː.kəm.stæns/ (danh từ): hoàn cảnh. Thường dùng số nhiều: "in these circumstances" = trong hoàn cảnh này.
items.explanationEn: circumstance /ˈsɝː.kəm.stæns/ (noun): a situation. Usually plural: "in these circumstances".

items.question: Trong câu "Many UX problems are really missing-flow problems, not aesthetic ones.", từ "aesthetic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many UX problems are really missing-flow problems, not aesthetic ones.", what does "aesthetic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: aesthetic /esˈθet̬.ɪk/ (tính từ): thuộc thẩm mỹ. Danh từ: aesthetics (thẩm mỹ học); đừng nhầm với anaesthetic (thuốc mê).
items.explanationEn: aesthetic /esˈθet̬.ɪk/ (adjective): visual. Noun: aesthetics; do not confuse with anaesthetic.

items.question: Trong câu "Supplying constraints and rules — mandatory data, value limits, permissions, what error messages must say.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Supplying constraints and rules — mandatory data, value limits, permissions, what error messages must say.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. Danh từ: supplier; "supply and demand" = cung và cầu.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. Noun: supplier; "supply and demand".

items.question: Trong câu "Supplying constraints and rules — mandatory data, value limits, permissions, what error messages must say.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Supplying constraints and rules — mandatory data, value limits, permissions, what error messages must say.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc. "Time / budget constraints" = ràng buộc thời gian / ngân sách; động từ: constrain.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limiting rule. "Time or budget constraints"; verb: constrain.

items.question: Trong câu "Specifying usability requirements in measurable form", từ "usability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specifying usability requirements in measurable form", what does "usability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usability /ˌjuː.zəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): tính dễ dùng. Usability (dễ dùng) khác usefulness (có ích); "usability testing" = kiểm thử độ dễ dùng.
items.explanationEn: usability /ˌjuː.zəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): ease of use. Usability (ease of use) differs from usefulness; "usability testing".

items.question: Trong câu "Specifying usability requirements in measurable form", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specifying usability requirements in measurable form", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. Yêu cầu tốt phải "measurable" để kiểm chứng; tiêu chí SMART có chữ M = Measurable.
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): quantifiable. Good requirements must be measurable to verify; the M in SMART stands for Measurable.

items.question: Trong câu "Hidden entirely, or shown disabled with an explanation?", từ "disabled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hidden entirely, or shown disabled with an explanation?", what does "disabled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (tính từ): bị vô hiệu hóa. Trong UI, "disabled button" = nút bị mờ không bấm được; nghĩa khác: người khuyết tật.
items.explanationEn: disabled /dɪˈseɪ.bəld/ (adjective): turned off. In UI, a "disabled button" cannot be clicked; it also describes people with a disability.

items.question: Trong câu "Which actions are irreversible, and do they need confirmation?", từ "irreversible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which actions are irreversible, and do they need confirmation?", what does "irreversible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: irreversible /ˌɪr.ɪˈvɝː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): không hoàn tác được. Trái nghĩa: reversible; hành động không thể hoàn tác nên cần hộp xác nhận.
items.explanationEn: irreversible /ˌɪr.ɪˈvɝː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to undo. Opposite: reversible; actions that cannot be undone need a confirmation step.

items.question: Trong câu "Which actions are irreversible, and do they need confirmation?", từ "confirmation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which actions are irreversible, and do they need confirmation?", what does "confirmation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confirmation /ˌkɑːn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận. "Confirmation dialog" = hộp thoại xác nhận; động từ: confirm.
items.explanationEn: confirmation /ˌkɑːn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): verification. "Confirmation dialog"; verb: confirm.

items.question: Trong câu "and the three that real users hit far more often than we assume.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and the three that real users hit far more often than we assume.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsuːm/ (động từ): cho rằng. Danh từ: assumption (giả định); nghĩa khác: assume a role = đảm nhận vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsuːm/ (verb): to suppose. Noun: assumption; "assume a role" means to take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "These three words get used interchangeably.", từ "interchangeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three words get used interchangeably.", what does "interchangeably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: interchangeably /ˌɪn.t̬ɚˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (trạng từ): thay thế nhau. Tính từ: interchangeable (có thể hoán đổi).
items.explanationEn: interchangeably /ˌɪn.t̬ɚˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (adverb): as if the same. Adjective: interchangeable.

items.question: Trong câu "They differ in fidelity and purpose.", từ "fidelity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They differ in fidelity and purpose.", what does "fidelity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fidelity /fɪˈdel.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): độ chi tiết. "Low-fidelity / high-fidelity" (lo-fi / hi-fi) = độ chi tiết thấp / cao; nghĩa khác: lòng chung thủy.
items.explanationEn: fidelity /fɪˈdel.ə.t̬i/ (noun): realism. "Low-fidelity or high-fidelity" (lo-fi, hi-fi) describe how realistic a design is; fidelity also means loyalty.

items.question: Trong câu "Once the structure is settled", từ "settled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once the structure is settled", what does "settled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: settled /ˈset̬.əld/ (tính từ): đã chốt. "The matter is settled" = vấn đề đã được quyết; "settle a bill" = thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: settled /ˈset̬.əld/ (adjective): decided. "The matter is settled" means decided; "settle a bill" means pay it.

items.question: Trong câu "You need no design skill to draw boxes and labels — and that crudeness is precisely the advantage.", từ "crudeness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need no design skill to draw boxes and labels — and that crudeness is precisely the advantage.", what does "crudeness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: crudeness /ˈkruːd.nəs/ (danh từ): sự thô sơ. Tính từ: crude (thô, sơ sài); "crude oil" = dầu thô; crude joke = trò đùa thô tục.
items.explanationEn: crudeness /ˈkruːd.nəs/ (noun): roughness. Adjective: crude; "crude oil"; a crude joke is vulgar.

items.question: Trong câu "You need no design skill to draw boxes and labels — and that crudeness is precisely the advantage.", từ "label" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need no design skill to draw boxes and labels — and that crudeness is precisely the advantage.", what does "label" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (danh từ): nhãn chữ. Trong form, label = nhãn mô tả ô nhập; "record label" = hãng đĩa.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (noun): a text tag. In forms, a label names an input field; a "record label" is a music company.

items.question: Trong câu "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", từ "paradox" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", what does "paradox" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: paradox /ˈper.ə.dɑːks/ (danh từ): nghịch lý. Tính từ: paradoxical; "paradoxically" = nghịch lý thay.
items.explanationEn: paradox /ˈper.ə.dɑːks/ (noun): a contradiction. Adjective: paradoxical; "paradoxically".

items.question: Trong câu "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A powerful paradox: the cruder the prototype, the more valuable the early feedback.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (danh từ): ý kiến phản hồi. "Give / get feedback" = góp ý / nhận góp ý; nghĩa kỹ thuật: tiếng hú micro.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (noun): comments. "Give or get feedback"; technically, audio feedback is a squeal from speakers.

items.question: Trong câu "Show a polished design and people comment on button colours.", từ "polished" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Show a polished design and people comment on button colours.", what does "polished" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: polished /ˈpɑː.lɪʃt/ (tính từ): trau chuốt. "Polished design" = thiết kế hoàn thiện; nghĩa đen: được đánh bóng. Chú ý Polish (Ba Lan) viết hoa.
items.explanationEn: polished /ˈpɑː.lɪʃt/ (adjective): finished-looking. A "polished design" looks finished; literally, rubbed shiny. Note Polish (from Poland) is capitalised.

items.question: Trong câu "Show a polished design and people comment on button colours.", từ "comment on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Show a polished design and people comment on button colours.", what does "comment on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: comment on /ˈkɑː.ment ɑːn/ (cụm từ): nhận xét về. "Comment on something" = nêu nhận xét về điều gì; danh từ: comment.
items.explanationEn: comment on /ˈkɑː.ment ɑːn/ (phrase): to remark about. "Comment on something" means give an opinion about it.

items.question: Trong câu "Users also hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, yet have no hesitation criticising a sketch.", từ "hesitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users also hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, yet have no hesitation criticising a sketch.", what does "hesitate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hesitate /ˈhez.ə.teɪt/ (động từ): ngần ngại. Danh từ: hesitation; "don't hesitate to ask" = cứ hỏi đừng ngại.
items.explanationEn: hesitate /ˈhez.ə.teɪt/ (verb): to hold back. Noun: hesitation; "don't hesitate to ask".

items.question: Trong câu "Users also hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, yet have no hesitation criticising a sketch.", từ "criticise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users also hesitate to criticise something that looks finished, yet have no hesitation criticising a sketch.", what does "criticise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: criticise /ˈkrɪt̬.ə.saɪz/ (động từ): chỉ trích. Anh-Mỹ: criticize; danh từ: criticism, critic.
items.explanationEn: criticise /ˈkrɪt̬.ə.saɪz/ (verb): to find fault. American spelling: criticize; nouns: criticism, critic.

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing forces you to answer questions prose lets you dodge: where does this field go, how is this list sorted, what does the user press to go back?", từ "dodge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing forces you to answer questions prose lets you dodge: where does this field go, how is this list sorted, what does the user press to go back?", what does "dodge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dodge /dɑːdʒ/ (động từ): né tránh. "Dodge a question" = né câu hỏi; nghĩa đen: né người sang bên.
items.explanationEn: dodge /dɑːdʒ/ (verb): to avoid. "Dodge a question" means avoid it; literally, to move quickly aside.

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing forces you to answer questions prose lets you dodge: where does this field go, how is this list sorted, what does the user press to go back?", từ "prose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing forces you to answer questions prose lets you dodge: where does this field go, how is this list sorted, what does the user press to go back?", what does "prose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prose /proʊz/ (danh từ): văn xuôi. Đối lập với verse (thơ); ở đây là mô tả bằng chữ thay vì hình vẽ. Đừng nhầm với "pros" (ưu điểm).
items.explanationEn: prose /proʊz/ (noun): written text. Opposite of verse; here, written description instead of drawings. Do not confuse with "pros" (advantages).

items.question: Trong câu "Conveying context to designers and developers — not for them to copy exactly, but so they understand the intent.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conveying context to designers and developers — not for them to copy exactly, but so they understand the intent.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định. Tính từ intent on = quyết tâm; "design intent" = ý đồ thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): the purpose. Adjective "intent on" means determined; "design intent" is the purpose of a design.

items.question: Trong câu "Conveying context to designers and developers — not for them to copy exactly, but so they understand the intent.", từ "context" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conveying context to designers and developers — not for them to copy exactly, but so they understand the intent.", what does "context" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: context /ˈkɑːn.tekst/ (danh từ): bối cảnh. "In this context" = trong bối cảnh này; "out of context" = tách khỏi ngữ cảnh.
items.explanationEn: context /ˈkɑːn.tekst/ (noun): background. "In this context"; "out of context" means without the surrounding situation.

items.question: Trong câu "Annotate the behaviour beside it", từ "annotate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Annotate the behaviour beside it", what does "annotate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: annotate /ˈæn.ə.teɪt/ (động từ): ghi chú thích. Danh từ: annotation; "annotated wireframe" = wireframe có chú thích hành vi.
items.explanationEn: annotate /ˈæn.ə.teɪt/ (verb): to add notes to. Noun: annotation; an "annotated wireframe" has behaviour notes.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw the empty and error states too, not only the fully populated one.", từ "populated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw the empty and error states too, not only the fully populated one.", what does "populated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: populated /ˈpɑː.pjə.leɪ.t̬ɪd/ (tính từ): đầy dữ liệu. "Populate a form / table" = điền dữ liệu; "densely populated" = đông dân.
items.explanationEn: populated /ˈpɑː.pjə.leɪ.t̬ɪd/ (adjective): filled with data. "Populate a form or table" means fill it with data; "densely populated" refers to people.

items.question: Trong câu "Use plausible data", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use plausible data", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɑː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): như thật. Trái nghĩa: implausible; "plausible data" = dữ liệu trông như thật.
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɑː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): believable. Opposite: implausible; "plausible data" looks realistic.

items.question: Trong câu "The essential thing to say every time you present a wireframe: this is a sketch of STRUCTURE and FLOW, not the final design.", từ "essential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The essential thing to say every time you present a wireframe: this is a sketch of STRUCTURE and FLOW, not the final design.", what does "essential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: essential /ɪˈsen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): thiết yếu. Danh từ số nhiều: essentials (những thứ cơ bản); "essential oil" = tinh dầu.
items.explanationEn: essential /ɪˈsen.ʃəl/ (adjective): vital. Plural noun: essentials; "essential oil" is an aromatic extract.

items.question: Trong câu "Without that, you get the wrong kind of feedback and the designer feels encroached upon.", từ "encroach upon" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without that, you get the wrong kind of feedback and the designer feels encroached upon.", what does "encroach upon" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: encroach upon /ɪnˈkroʊtʃ əˈpɑːn/ (cụm từ): bị lấn sân. "Encroach on someone's role" = lấn sang phạm vi công việc của người khác.
items.explanationEn: encroach upon /ɪnˈkroʊtʃ əˈpɑːn/ (phrase): to be intruded on. "Encroach on someone's role" means intruding into their area of work.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most friction-prone boundary and deserves stating clearly.", từ "friction-prone" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most friction-prone boundary and deserves stating clearly.", what does "friction-prone" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: friction-prone /ˈfrɪk.ʃən proʊn/ (tính từ): dễ gây va chạm. Friction = ma sát, va chạm giữa người; hậu tố -prone = dễ bị (error-prone).
items.explanationEn: friction-prone /ˈfrɪk.ʃən proʊn/ (adjective): prone to conflict. Friction is conflict between people; suffix -prone means likely to (error-prone).

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most friction-prone boundary and deserves stating clearly.", từ "deserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most friction-prone boundary and deserves stating clearly.", what does "deserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deserve /dɪˈzɝːv/ (động từ): xứng đáng. "Deserve attention" = đáng được chú ý; danh từ liên quan: well-deserved.
items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɝːv/ (verb): to merit. "Deserve attention"; related: well-deserved.

items.question: Trong câu "A common BA mistake: over-specifying the interface.", từ "over-specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common BA mistake: over-specifying the interface.", what does "over-specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: over-specify /ˌoʊ.vɚˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): đặc tả quá chi tiết. Đặc tả quá mức giao diện là lấn sang việc của designer.
items.explanationEn: over-specify /ˌoʊ.vɚˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to define too precisely. Over-specifying the interface intrudes on the designer's work.

items.question: Trong câu "is usually not a requirement but a design decision in disguise.", từ "in disguise" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is usually not a requirement but a design decision in disguise.", what does "in disguise" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in disguise /ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (cụm từ): trá hình. "A blessing in disguise" = trong cái rủi có cái may.
items.explanationEn: in disguise /ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (phrase): disguised. "A blessing in disguise" is something good that first seemed bad.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "genuine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "genuine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (tính từ): thực sự, xác đáng. "Genuine leather" = da thật; "genuine reason" = lý do thực sự.
items.explanationEn: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (adjective): real. "Genuine leather" is real leather; a "genuine reason" is a real one.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "consistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "consistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): tính nhất quán. Tính từ: consistent; nghĩa khác: độ đặc của chất lỏng.
items.explanationEn: consistency /kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): uniformity. Adjective: consistent; also the thickness of a liquid.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "accessibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "accessibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: accessibility /əkˌses.əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): khả năng tiếp cận. Viết tắt a11y; chuẩn WCAG quy định accessibility cho web.
items.explanationEn: accessibility /əkˌses.əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): inclusive usability. Often written a11y; WCAG defines web accessibility.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ. Động từ: comply with; "compliance with regulations" = tuân thủ quy định.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): conformity. Verb: comply with; "compliance with regulations".

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "established" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "established" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: established /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃt/ (tính từ): đã thành nếp. "Established convention" = quy ước đã quen thuộc; động từ establish = thiết lập.
items.explanationEn: established /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃt/ (adjective): long accepted. "Established convention" is widely accepted; verb establish means to set up.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "expectation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "expectation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expectation /ˌek.spekˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự kỳ vọng. "Meet / manage expectations" = đáp ứng / quản lý kỳ vọng; cụm rất hay dùng nơi công sở.
items.explanationEn: expectation /ˌek.spekˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): an anticipation. "Meet or manage expectations"; very common at work.

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt̬.ə.mət/ (tính từ): chính đáng. Trái nghĩa: illegitimate; "legitimate concern" = mối lo chính đáng.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt̬.ə.mət/ (adjective): justifiable. Opposite: illegitimate; "legitimate concern".

items.question: Trong câu "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the answer is a genuine business reason — consistency with an existing application, accessibility compliance, an established user expectation — then it is a legitimate design constraint, so record it with its rationale.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnæl/ (danh từ): lý do căn bản. Ghi lại "rationale" giúp người sau hiểu vì sao có quyết định; khác rational (hợp lý).
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnæl/ (noun): the underlying reason. Recording the rationale explains why a decision was made; different from rational.

items.question: Trong câu "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpoʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose a rule / a tax" = áp đặt quy tắc / thuế.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpoʊz/ (verb): to force upon. "Impose a rule or a tax".

items.question: Trong câu "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", từ "prematurely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", what does "prematurely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: prematurely /ˌpriː.məˈtʃʊr.li/ (trạng từ): quá sớm. Tính từ: premature; "premature optimization" = tối ưu hóa quá sớm.
items.explanationEn: prematurely /ˌpriː.məˈtʃʊr.li/ (adverb): too early. Adjective: premature; "premature optimization".

items.question: Trong câu "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", từ "frustrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", what does "frustrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: frustrate /ˈfrʌs.treɪt/ (động từ): làm bực bội. Tính từ: frustrated (bực bội), frustrating (gây bực); danh từ: frustration.
items.explanationEn: frustrate /ˈfrʌs.treɪt/ (verb): to annoy. Adjectives: frustrated, frustrating; noun: frustration.

items.question: Trong câu "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", từ "suboptimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design constraints imposed unnecessarily, prematurely, or for the wrong reasons frustrate both designers and developers, and can lead to a suboptimal product.", what does "suboptimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: suboptimal /sʌbˈɑːp.tə.məl/ (tính từ): chưa tối ưu. Tiền tố sub- = dưới mức; "optimal" = tối ưu.
items.explanationEn: suboptimal /sʌbˈɑːp.tə.məl/ (adjective): less than best. Prefix sub- means below; optimal means best.

items.question: Trong câu "How to translate it into measurable characteristics:", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to translate it into measurable characteristics:", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển thành. "Translate A into B" = biến A thành B; nghĩa thường gặp: dịch.
items.explanationEn: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (verb): to convert into. "Translate A into B" means convert it; the usual sense is putting words into another language.

items.question: Trong câu "How to translate it into measurable characteristics:", từ "characteristic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to translate it into measurable characteristics:", what does "characteristic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: characteristic /ˌker.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (danh từ): đặc điểm. Tính từ characteristic of = đặc trưng của.
items.explanationEn: characteristic /ˌker.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (noun): a typical feature. Adjective "characteristic of" means typical of.

items.question: Trong câu "An important note: ease of learning and efficiency for experts are DIFFERENT and often conflicting goals.", từ "efficiency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important note: ease of learning and efficiency for experts are DIFFERENT and often conflicting goals.", what does "efficiency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (danh từ): hiệu suất. Phân biệt efficiency (làm nhanh, ít lãng phí) với effectiveness (đạt đúng mục tiêu).
items.explanationEn: efficiency /ɪˈfɪʃ.ən.si/ (noun): productivity. Distinguish efficiency (little waste) from effectiveness (achieving the aim).

items.question: Trong câu "An important note: ease of learning and efficiency for experts are DIFFERENT and often conflicting goals.", từ "conflicting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important note: ease of learning and efficiency for experts are DIFFERENT and often conflicting goals.", what does "conflicting" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conflicting /kənˈflɪk.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Conflicting requirements" = yêu cầu mâu thuẫn; danh từ: conflict.
items.explanationEn: conflicting /kənˈflɪk.tɪŋ/ (adjective): opposing. "Conflicting requirements"; noun: conflict.

items.question: Trong câu "A wizard-heavy interface is easy to learn but slows experts.", từ "wizard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A wizard-heavy interface is easy to learn but slows experts.", what does "wizard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: wizard /ˈwɪz.ɚd/ (danh từ): trình hướng dẫn. Trong UI, wizard = chuỗi màn hình dẫn từng bước; nghĩa gốc: phù thủy.
items.explanationEn: wizard /ˈwɪz.ɚd/ (noun): a step-by-step dialog. In UI, a wizard is a step-by-step dialog; the original sense is a magician.

items.question: Trong câu "A shortcut-heavy interface is efficient but hard to learn.", từ "shortcut" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A shortcut-heavy interface is efficient but hard to learn.", what does "shortcut" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shortcut /ˈʃɔːrt.kʌt/ (danh từ): phím tắt. "Keyboard shortcut" = phím tắt; "take a shortcut" = đi đường tắt.
items.explanationEn: shortcut /ˈʃɔːrt.kʌt/ (noun): a quick key command. "Keyboard shortcut"; "take a shortcut" means use a shorter route.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA must know which user class matters more, and that is a question for stakeholders rather than something for the designer to guess.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA must know which user class matters more, and that is a question for stakeholders rather than something for the designer to guess.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪk.hoʊl.dɚ/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. Từ cốt lõi của BA: stakeholder analysis = phân tích các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪk.hoʊl.dɚ/ (noun): an interested party. A core BA word: stakeholder analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "You do not need a professional lab.", từ "professional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You do not need a professional lab.", what does "professional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: professional /prəˈfeʃ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): chuyên nghiệp. Danh từ professional = người chuyên nghiệp; trái nghĩa: amateur.
items.explanationEn: professional /prəˈfeʃ.ən.əl/ (adjective): expert-level. As a noun, a professional is an expert; opposite: amateur.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple session with five real users surfaces most of the serious problems.", từ "session" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple session with five real users surfaces most of the serious problems.", what does "session" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: session /ˈseʃ.ən/ (danh từ): buổi làm việc. Nghĩa trong phần mềm: phiên đăng nhập; ở đây là một buổi kiểm thử.
items.explanationEn: session /ˈseʃ.ən/ (noun): a period of activity. In software a session is a login period; here it is one testing meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple session with five real users surfaces most of the serious problems.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple session with five real users surfaces most of the serious problems.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to rise to the top of water
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. Động từ surface = làm lộ ra (vấn đề); danh từ surface = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (verb): to bring to light. The verb surface means to bring issues to light; the noun means the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Give a TASK, not a tour.", từ "tour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Give a TASK, not a tour.", what does "tour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tour /tʊr/ (danh từ): chuyến tham quan. "Product tour" = màn giới thiệu sản phẩm; "tour of duty" = nhiệm kỳ.
items.explanationEn: tour /tʊr/ (noun): a guided visit. "Product tour" is a guided introduction; "tour of duty" is a period of service.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not walk them through the screens.", từ "walk through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not walk them through the screens.", what does "walk through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: walk through /wɑːk θruː/ (cụm từ): dẫn đi qua. "Walk someone through something" = hướng dẫn ai từng bước.
items.explanationEn: walk through /wɑːk θruː/ (phrase): to guide step by step. "Walk someone through something" means guide them step by step.

items.question: Trong câu "then watch in silence.", từ "in silence" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "then watch in silence.", what does "in silence" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in silence /ɪn ˈsaɪ.ləns/ (cụm từ): im lặng. Tính từ: silent; "watch in silence" = quan sát mà không nói gì.
items.explanationEn: in silence /ɪn ˈsaɪ.ləns/ (phrase): without speaking. Adjective: silent; "watch in silence" means observe without talking.

items.question: Trong câu "Wherever they pause, hesitate, or go wrong is where the design has a problem.", từ "wherever" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wherever they pause, hesitate, or go wrong is where the design has a problem.", what does "wherever" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: wherever /werˈev.ɚ/ (liên từ): bất cứ chỗ nào. So sánh: wherever (bất cứ nơi đâu), whenever (bất cứ khi nào), however (dù thế nào).
items.explanationEn: wherever /werˈev.ɚ/ (conjunction): at any place. Compare: wherever (any place), whenever (any time), however (any way).

items.question: Trong câu "Wherever they pause, hesitate, or go wrong is where the design has a problem.", từ "pause" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wherever they pause, hesitate, or go wrong is where the design has a problem.", what does "pause" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pause /pɑːz/ (động từ): ngừng lại. Danh từ pause = khoảng dừng; nút "pause" trên trình phát.
items.explanationEn: pause /pɑːz/ (verb): to stop. As a noun, a pause is a short stop; the pause button on a player.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not explain when they get stuck.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not explain when they get stuck.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to be in a traffic jam
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị bí. "Get stuck on a step" = bị bí ở một bước.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to continue. "Get stuck on a step" means be unable to continue.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the PROBLEM, not the solution they propose.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the PROBLEM, not the solution they propose.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpoʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. Danh từ: proposal (đề xuất); nghĩa khác: cầu hôn.
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpoʊz/ (verb): to suggest. Noun: proposal; it also means to ask someone to marry.

items.question: Trong câu "Solutions are the designer's job; the problem is the valuable data.", từ "valuable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Solutions are the designer's job; the problem is the valuable data.", what does "valuable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valuable /ˈvæl.jə.bəl/ (tính từ): có giá trị. Danh từ số nhiều valuables = đồ quý giá.
items.explanationEn: valuable /ˈvæl.jə.bəl/ (adjective): useful. Plural noun: valuables, meaning precious possessions.

items.question: Trong câu "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", từ "surprising" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", what does "surprising" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: surprising /sɚˈpraɪ.zɪŋ/ (tính từ): đáng ngạc nhiên. Phân biệt surprising (gây ngạc nhiên) và surprised (cảm thấy ngạc nhiên).
items.explanationEn: surprising /sɚˈpraɪ.zɪŋ/ (adjective): unexpected. Distinguish surprising (causing surprise) from surprised (feeling it).

items.question: Trong câu "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", từ "dislike" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", what does "dislike" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dislike /dɪsˈlaɪk/ (động từ): không thích. Danh từ: dislike; "likes and dislikes" = sở thích và điều không thích.
items.explanationEn: dislike /dɪsˈlaɪk/ (verb): to not like. Noun: dislike; "likes and dislikes".

items.question: Trong câu "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", từ "obvious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most surprising result in usability testing is usually not that users dislike something, but that they DO NOT SEE something you considered obvious.", what does "obvious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: obvious /ˈɑːb.vi.əs/ (tính từ): hiển nhiên. Trạng từ: obviously; trái nghĩa: subtle, hidden.
items.explanationEn: obvious /ˈɑːb.vi.əs/ (adjective): easy to see. Adverb: obviously; opposites: subtle, hidden.

items.question: Trong câu "A product can have beautiful UI and terrible UX if the task flow meanders and mistakes cannot be corrected.", từ "meander" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product can have beautiful UI and terrible UX if the task flow meanders and mistakes cannot be corrected.", what does "meander" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: meander /miˈæn.dɚ/ (động từ): lòng vòng. Nghĩa gốc: dòng sông uốn khúc; luồng "meander" là đi vòng vèo, không thẳng tới mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: meander /miˈæn.dɚ/ (verb): to wander. Literally a winding river; a meandering flow wanders instead of going straight to the goal.

items.question: Trong câu "Wireframes for structure, mockups for appearance, prototypes for interaction — three different purposes.", từ "appearance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wireframes for structure, mockups for appearance, prototypes for interaction — three different purposes.", what does "appearance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: appearance /əˈpɪr.əns/ (danh từ): vẻ bề ngoài. Nghĩa khác: "make an appearance" = xuất hiện; động từ: appear.
items.explanationEn: appearance /əˈpɪr.əns/ (noun): the look. Another sense: "make an appearance" means show up; verb: appear.

items.question: Trong câu "Wireframes are the BA's thinking and communication tool, not a design deliverable.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wireframes are the BA's thinking and communication tool, not a design deliverable.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. Từ quản lý dự án: deliverable = kết quả đầu ra phải bàn giao.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ɚ.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output. A project-management word: a deliverable is an output you must hand over.

items.question: Trong câu "Respect the boundary with designers — specify the need and the flow, leave the appearance to the specialists.", từ "specialist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Respect the boundary with designers — specify the need and the flow, leave the appearance to the specialists.", what does "specialist" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: specialist /ˈspeʃ.əl.ɪst/ (danh từ): chuyên gia. Tính từ: specialised; "non-specialist" = người không chuyên.
items.explanationEn: specialist /ˈspeʃ.əl.ɪst/ (noun): an expert. Adjective: specialised; "non-specialist".

items.question: Trong câu "Testing with five real users surfaces most serious problems, provided you give tasks and watch in silence.", từ "provided" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testing with five real users surfaces most serious problems, provided you give tasks and watch in silence.", what does "provided" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (liên từ): miễn là. Đồng nghĩa: providing, as long as, on condition that.
items.explanationEn: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (conjunction): as long as. Synonyms: providing, as long as, on condition that.
